headline: Start of the Amber Highway by Luis Abinader in Puerto Plata
summary: President Luis Abinader will formally begin construction of the Ámbar Highway in Puerto Plata on Friday, November 27, the presidency minister announced.
why: Major road infrastructure projects can stimulate construction activity and improve trade logistics, which matters for regional economic growth.
original_headline: Inicio de la autopista del ámbar por luis abinader en puerto plata
